headline: Pakistan Inflation Reaches 10% as Policy Rate Forecasts Divide
summary: Pakistan's inflation reached 10%, creating divided expectations among analysts ahead of the central bank's upcoming interest rate announcement.
why: The State Bank of Pakistan uses the policy rate to balance price stability with economic growth amid ongoing macroeconomic adjustments.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: A 10% inflation print leaves the central bank's next interest rate trajectory uncertain.
